candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Di pikin get cough or e dey breathe with wahala. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear wahala. E no get fever. Dem no see say di pikin dey convulse now. E never get convulsion before. E no dey act like person wey dey sleep too much or wey no dey gree wake. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. Dem count di pikin breath for one full minute. Di pikin chest no dey go inside when e dey breathe. Di pikin calm when dem dey check am. Cough don last for 3 days. Pulse oximeter dey available. Di pikin no dey get wheeze come back. Di pikin dey breathe 35 times for one minute. When di pikin calm, e no get stridor. Dem no hear wheezing for di pikin.
